plugins.description: OpenRouter for tools — 2,896 agent-callable endpoints across 60 providers: SEO and SERP data, backlinks, social and trends, people and company enrichment, ads, scraping. Search by the task, see the price, then call it. Credentials are injected server-side, so the agent never holds a key. Pay per call, not per subscription.
